description.p: Bulk Renamer renames many files at once. Combine simple rules, check every new name in a live preview before anything changes, and undo whole batches later if you change your mind.

ul.li: Find and replace text, optionally with regular expressions
Change case, insert or remove text, trim and pad names
Use photo (EXIF) and music (ID3) details in file names
Tidy up messy names and transliterate Greek or Cyrillic to Latin
Live preview with conflict detection before renaming
Undo, redo and a history of past renames
Presets, CSV import and a command-line mode

screenshot.caption: Main window with files, renaming rules and the preview

description.p: First release, made for Fedora with the GNOME desktop: rule-based renaming with a live preview, undo and a rename history, crash recovery, presets, CSV import and a command-line mode, with partial translations into 10 languages.
